extra/lab2_fullft_complete.txt.title: One training string per ticket
note: **Joins prompt, correct answer, and an end token into one string to train on.**

extra/lab2_fullft_complete.txt.title: Data collator
note: **Pads each batch to equal length and marks what the model is graded on.**
- Padding positions get -100, meaning 'don't grade this'

extra/lab2_fullft_complete.txt.title: Training settings
note: **How long, how fast, and on what hardware to train.**

- `warmup_steps=0.05`: ease in over the first 5% of steps (5%, not 0.05 steps)

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: LoRA settings
note: **How big the adapters are, and which layers they attach to.**
- `r`: adapter size. `lora_alpha`: how strongly it counts (2 x r)
- `lora_dropout`: ignores 5% of the adapter at random while training, so it doesn't just memorize
- `target_modules`: every name STEP 2 printed except `lm_head`

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Attach the adapters
note: **Freezes the model and adds small trainable adapters next to its layers.**
- The printed line shows only about 2% of the model will train

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Grade only the answer
note: **Marks the prompt part -100 ("don't grade"), so only the answer is graded.**
- Lab 2 also graded the model on retyping the ticket

extra/lab3_lora_complete.txt.title: Hand the data to the Trainer
note: **Same Trainer as Lab 2, but now it trains only the adapters.**
- Padding is marked -100 too, so filler is never graded

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: 4-bit quantization settings
note: **Store the frozen model in 4 bits instead of 32 to save memory.**
- `nf4`: a 4-bit format designed for the numbers in a model
- Calculations still run at 16 bits; double quant saves a bit more memory

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Load the model in 4-bit

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Prepare a 4-bit model for training
note: **Switches a few delicate layers to full size so training on a 4-bit model stays steady.**
- `use_gradient_checkpointing=False`: skips a memory-saving trick that would make training even slower

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Same LoRA settings as Lab 3
note: **Identical adapter settings to Lab 3 — only the base model's storage changed.**
- So the differences from Lab 3 are the 4-bit model and the number of training steps

extra/lab4_qlora_complete.txt.title: Merge the adapter
note: **Loads the trained adapter and folds it permanently into the base model.**
- Merged into a 16-bit base, never the 4-bit one
- The result is an ordinary model with no adapter files

extra/lab5_eval_complete.txt.title: Attach the Lab 3 adapter
note: **Loads the base model and puts your Lab 3 adapter back on top.**
- This is how an adapter is used outside the training script

extra/lab5_eval_complete.txt.title: Tally right and wrong per category
note: **Counts correct answers per category and records each mix-up.**
- The mix-ups print in STEP 3 as right category -> model's answer
